shells_consumed_nodal_state.direct_consumption_note: The modified FEG contains the nodal state produced/preserved by OrbData; Shells also consumes global material and rheology parameters. This report distinguishes that nodal state from model configuration.

density_implementation.conceptual_form: rho_local = rho_reference * thermal_correction(local_temperature, alphaT, geotherm/depth) + chemical_delta_rho
density_implementation.layer_reference_densities: rhoBar is separate crustal/mantle reference or mean density under the model's reference thermodynamic conditions; rhoAst is the asthenosphere reference density. They are global specialist physical-model parameters, not lateral WORLD_HISTORY density rasters.
density_implementation.chemical_delta_rho: An effective, node-wise lithospheric density correction of chemical origin, adjusted/used by OrbData in the isostatic structural construction and constrained by a configured bound. It is not absolute density(P,T,composition), a mineral assemblage, or a bulk composition.
density_implementation.composition_requirement: No bulk composition, mineral assemblage or phase fractions are required by the minimum reduced density semantics described in the source evidence.
density_implementation.qualification: Conceptual formula records source-defined term roles; it does not reproduce every code coefficient or interpolation detail. No numeric coefficients or defaults are promoted into ARCANA.

pressure_requirement.internal_reference_pressure: Squeez constructs a vertical reference-pressure column internally from reference density, surface gravity and depth increments.
pressure_requirement.internal_stress_anomaly: Squeez integrates vertical standardized stress anomaly through the plate and returns tauZZ and sigZZB; Assign checks basal anomaly against its isostatic consistency condition.
pressure_requirement.effective_fault_pressure: Treat friction/fault pressure terms separately from absolute thermodynamic pressure; a fault pressure variable does not imply an external EOS field. Exact coefficients remain specialist configuration.

gravity_requirement.meaning: Mean/surface gravitational acceleration used to build the internal reference column in the inspected path.

reference_density_semantics.rhoBar_crust: Crust reference/mean material density at the model's reference thermodynamic conditions; specialist physical-model parameter, not a nodal history field.
reference_density_semantics.rhoBar_mantle: Mantle-lithosphere reference/mean material density at the model's reference thermodynamic conditions; specialist physical-model parameter, not a nodal history field.
reference_density_semantics.rhoAst: Asthenosphere reference density used for the reference/structural column; specialist physical-model parameter.
reference_density_semantics.lateral_variation: The reference values are model parameters; lateral local density variation arises through thermal and chemical anomaly terms in the reduced formulation.

chemical_density_anomaly_semantics.role: effective lithosphere-property correction of chemical origin used in the internal structure/isostasy formulation
chemical_density_anomaly_semantics.isostatic_consistency: OrbData uses/adjusts it along with cooling curvature as degrees of freedom when constructing the structure; Assign checks basal stress anomaly consistency.
chemical_density_anomaly_semantics.bounded: yes, by a configured source limit; numeric bound is not copied into ARCANA
